title: Cavernous Maws
requirements: Wings of the Goddess content enabled.
steps: Examine a starting maw in Rolanberry Fields (H-6), Batallia Downs (H-5), or Sauromugue Champaign (J-10). Rolanberry is a straightforward first route from Jeuno.
Finish the scene to receive the Pure white feather and enter a Shadowreign area. Check which past zone you arrived in before leaving.
Use other maws from their past side to activate their present-day entrances. If you leave before opening alternatives, return through the first starting maw that admitted you.
reward: Pure white feather; access to the past.

title: Back to the Beginning
requirements: To finish this mission: complete one introductory national chain through Claws of the Griffon, Fires of Discontent, or The Tigress Strikes.
steps: Obtain a recommendation: Randecque in Garlaige Citadel [S] (I-6) for San d'Oria; Turbulent Storm in The Eldieme Necropolis [S] (J-9) for Bastok; or Kalsu-Kalasu in Crawlers' Nest [S] (L-8) for Windurst.
Join one past army: Steamed Rams (San d'Oria), The Fighting Fourth (Bastok), or Snake on the Plains (Windurst). Past allegiance is separate from your present nation.
Finish one introductory story pair: Gifts of the Griffon → Claws of the Griffon; Better Part of Valor → Fires of Discontent; or The Tigress Stirs → The Tigress Strikes.
Touch a Jeuno-area maw in Batallia Downs [S], Rolanberry Fields [S], or Sauromugue Champaign [S]. An already activated present counterpart also works. Watch Cait Sith's scene.
notes: One qualifying national chain is sufficient. You do not need to complete all three.

title: Cait Sith
requirements: To finish this mission: complete Wrath of the Griffon, Burden of Suspicion, or A Manifest Problem.

Walk into Southern San d'Oria [S] from East Ronfaure [S] for the mission scene. Teleporting directly into the city does not meet this zone-line trigger.
notes: National quests are in Quests → Crystal War, not the main WotG mission list.

title: The Queen of the Dance

Travel to present-day Upper Jeuno and speak with Turlough to receive the Mayakov show ticket.
Return to the past tavern and examine its door. Let the connected performance scenes finish; the ticket is consumed and the next mission begins.

title: Dancers in Distress

Finish Lilisette's questionnaire and note her requested item: Lynx Meat, Gold Beastcoin, or Nyumomo Doll. In the pinned core the item is selected randomly; an answer recipe cannot guarantee a particular request.
Leave Jugner Forest [S], obtain the requested item, return, and trade exactly that item to the Elegant Footprints.

title: Daughter of a Knight
requirements: During this mission, obtain one Cernunnos Bulb for Amaura's request.
steps: Speak with Amaura (G-6). Obtain a Cernunnos Bulb from Wandering Saplings in Jugner Forest [S] and trade it to her; this first trade shows the bulb without consuming it.
Trade the bulb to Humus-rich Earth at Maiden's Spring, Jugner Forest [S] (E-6), to plant it.
Visit the corresponding Humus-rich Earth in present-day Jugner Forest (E-6). Examine it for a scene, then again to spawn Cernunnos.
Defeat Cernunnos and examine the earth again before leaving to obtain Cernunnos resin.
Report to Amaura. Wait until the next Vana'diel day, leave the zone and return, then speak with her for the tonic. Talking too early requires another zone change.

title: A Nation on the Brink

steps: Climb the rampart to the tower at the J-9/K-9 boundary and examine the Underpass Hatch for the scene.
Examine it again with the Underpass hatch key to enter the Everbloom Hollow battle.

Assist the three allied units against two beastman waves each: Quadav northwest, Orcs northeast, and Yagudo south. After all waves fall, defeat One-eyed Gwajboj in the central area. Finish all connected scenes after victory.
After completion, examine the nearby ??? in Batallia Downs [S] for the Jeunoan Flag. If a retry consumes your key, return to the Bulwark Gate in Sauromugue Champaign [S] for a replacement.
reward: Battle of Jeuno Veteran title; Jeunoan Flag from the post-mission ???.

title: Proof of Valor
steps: Collect at least 20 signatures. A route with no item purchases is ten free signatures plus two quizzes.

Speak with Aissaville (I-7), Illeuse (H-9), Daigraffeaux (I-11), Elnonde (K-9), Remiotte (L-10), Loillie (K-9 upper level), Mailleronce (M-6), Andagge (H-9 upper level), Louxiard (G-7), and Machionage (C-6).
Answer Farouel (K-7): Smilodons; Tauri; Ghosts. Answer Vichauxdat (I-8): Three; Gutrenders; Grradhod. Correct answers add twelve signatures, bringing this route to 22.
Return to Raustigne at (I-7). If he still repeats an earlier count after you have enough, leave the zone and return. Accept his assessment to progress.
notes: Additional quizzes, item donations and the Rongelouts minigame improve the optional reward; they are unnecessary for story access.
The pinned core has an incomplete main-story battle at mission 14; later story handlers do not establish that this chapter is currently reachable on Zenith.
reward: 20–29 signatures: progression only; 30–40 Oxblood Orb; 41–80 Foulard; 81–99 Angel Skin Orb; 100–119 Orichalcum Ingot; 120 Molybdenum Ingot.

title: Storm's Crescendo
requirements: The Alchemical signal flare is obtained during this mission from Rally Point: Blue in Xarcabard [S].
steps: Examine Rally Point: Blue in northwest (H-8) for an Alchemical signal flare, then use the nearby Excavated Snow to enter the instance.
Speak with Antje to start the relay and receive Flee. Visit all 24 Republic Operatives while Flee is active; each conversation detonates a charge and refreshes the original effect.

Start south of Antje and follow the explosions counterclockwise: distant smoke points toward the next operative. The connected maps are 14, 15, 7 and 10. Keep moving past the tigers; ordinary speed equipment does not provide Flee.
Speaking to an operative without Flee resets the run; return to Antje to restart. After all 24 charges detonate, report to Antje, then examine Rally Point: Red (F-8) outside.
notes: A replacement flare after failure is limited to one per Vana'diel day. If several players enter, coordinate one runner; starting another speed effect can interfere with the first.

title: Her Memories
requirements: A Lilac, a Philosopher's Stone, Rice Vinegar, Ground Wasabi and Holy Basil are used by the subquests.
steps: Collect Large memory fragments I–IV through the linked subquests; their order is flexible. Start Of Malign Maladies early to run its day wait while doing the other routes.
For fragment I, start Homecoming Queen by walking from East Ronfaure into Southern San d'Oria, then complete Old Bean, The Faux Pas, and Grave Resolve.
For fragment II, complete Of Malign Maladies. For fragment III, complete Operation Cupid.

For fragment IV, complete the branch associated with your past allegiance: Carnelian Footfalls, Azure Footfalls, or Verdure Footfalls. You need one national fragment, not all three. Keep your allegiance unchanged during this stage.
Once all four large fragments are present, the next mission is assigned automatically.

steps: The Ronfaure dawndrop is already obtained. Collect the other seven by examining their glowing blank targets in any order.
Visit Jugner Forest [S] (I-6), across the river beside the familiar stump; La Vaule [S] southeast (K-9), beside the house; and Southern San d'Oria [S] (K-6), outside Lion Springs.
Visit Beaucedine Glacier [S] (H-9), down the ramp from the Campaign tower; Xarcabard [S] (F-8), beside Rally Point: Red; and Throne Room [S], in the central walkway.
Enter Walk of Echoes through Grauberg [S] (F-5) and examine its target south of the conflux. The eighth dawndrop combines the set into Primal glow.
If Walk of Echoes was your last stop, leave to Grauberg before starting Maiden of the Dusk.
notes: The pinned core has an incomplete main-story battle at mission 14; later story handlers do not establish that this chapter is currently reachable on Zenith.

title: Maiden of the Dusk
requirements: Carry the Primal glow awarded by Fork in the Road.
steps: Examine the Grauberg [S] conflux at (F-5) for the entry scene. In Walk of Echoes, examine the Ornate Door north of the entrance for another scene, then again to select the mission battle.
Defeat Lilith's first form. Turn away from Fatal Attraction to avoid its charm; watch area damage and knockback.
After the transition scene, use the brief opportunity to recover and rebuff. Defeat Lilith Ascendant while avoiding elemental gyves, especially the dark gyves with Doom.
Move away when she signals Dark Sun. Finish the connected victory scenes before leaving.
For another Primal glow, examine the Grauberg conflux; if a replacement was already issued that Vana’diel day, wait until the next day.
notes: The pinned core has an incomplete main-story battle at mission 14; later story handlers do not establish that this chapter is currently reachable on Zenith.
reward: Moonshade earring story key item; the equipment reward is selected later.

title: Lest We Forget
steps: Leave at least one inventory slot free and examine the Veridical Conflux at (F-5).
Choose one augment from each of the two displayed groups, review the combination, and confirm to receive the augmented Moonshade Earring.

The first group offers Accuracy, Attack, Ranged Accuracy, Ranged Attack, Magic Accuracy or Magic Attack Bonus +4, or HP/MP +25. The second group includes TP Bonus, Refresh, Regain and other situational effects; read the options before committing.
notes: This is the closing mission-log entry. Its presence in the current log after the reward does not itself mean the story is unfinished.
